column1: # Everyday chat words that written Bangla hardly uses: how people type them, the Bangla spellings in use,
# and a minimum frequency (per million) so they can compete with common written words. `ekushe-dict pack
# --keys` gives the typed spellings to whichever candidate the corpus uses most; a row whose candidates
# never occur in the corpus is skipped. Only words that came out wrong are listed (see eval/chat.tsv).
